name: DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH: TZAANGOR ENLIGHTENED
description: Tzaangor Enlightened are blessed amongst their mutated kind – they can see the skeins of fate through communion with Tzeentch. They surge atop daemonic Discs on the hunt for esoteric knowledge. In battle, they close on their targets, emitting screeches of anticipatory triumph, and their divining spears hum as they sense their predestined prey.</br></br>This multipart plastic kit builds three Tzaangor Enlightened, elite melee units for your Thousand Sons armies in games of Warhammer 40,000, or your Disciples of Tzeentch armies in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. They ride to battle atop bizarre, bladed Discs of Tzeentch, giving them great speed with which to get stuck in as fast as possible. The kit includes parts to build an optional champion, and the gouts of flame that raise up the discs are interchangeable. The miniatures can alternatively be built on foot, or as Tzaangor Skyfires – an elite ranged unit armed with ornate bows.</br></br>This kit comprises 62 plastic components, and 3x Citadel 40mm Round Bases. These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
